title: France Blames Iran for Sabotage Attack on Refrigeration Controllers at About 700 Retail Sites
summary: An October cyberattack on refrigeration controllers at about 700 French retail sites was carried out by a cyber unit of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), the French government said yesterday.
card_summary: An October cyberattack on refrigeration controllers at about 700 French retail sites was carried out by a cyber unit of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), the French government said yesterday.
email_summary: An October cyberattack on refrigeration controllers at about 700 French retail sites was carried out by a cyber unit of Iran's Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC), the French government said yesterday. The attackers broke into controllers on the night of October 11 and changed their defrost settings to high temperatures.

title: Google Issues Chrome Security Update for Eighth Actively Exploited Zero-Day of 2026
summary: Google on Monday released updates to patch nine security vulnerabilities, including one that has come under active exploitation in the wild.
